person.headline: Chief Executive Officer | @1st Enable ltd
person.about_me:
I am now working in different fields including a supported living company I helped found in 2012.  After in depth research we realised the time had come for care services in LD to evolve.  Our model has been a 100% success and we are leading the way across the North of England and Wales with people who would otherwise have lived in very restrictive environments play an active part in their future.  Many of the people we support have their own tenancies and even participate in work.

As part of this passion I have founded a training and consultancy company called Empeiria Training which literally means ‘knowledge by experience’.  We aim to take what we have learnt to ensure through other like minded care organisations, through partnership, we can help even more people live ordinary lives.

Following a serious cycling accident involving a car I am passionate about improving rehabilitation.  Pedal Devil is a cyclist centric service which aims to bring all parties together to react positively and put riders back on the road, track or trail where they belong.  Velo Expert is working for insurance companies and victims of RTAs (and even coroners offices) and means the claim can be settled quickly and accurately which benefits all involved.  This will keep both motor and cycling insurance premiums down.  We achieve this by lowering legal costs and passing on repair and replacement savings using services we have developed and the deals we have negotiated.

I have gained considerable experience of legal expense insurance and litigation funding up to and including board level at insurance companies.  I aim to continue to seek to provide services on a consultancy basis.

I previously worked setting up NHS Property Services with top UK builders and Homebuy agencies in preparation for Homebuy direct and other initiatives.  We gained 10000 leads within the first hour of going live.

Prior to that I worked as Head of Sales developing a Morgan Stanley company from a small regional mortgage packaging company to recruiting a highly professional and structured sales team and launching them into a mortgage lender.  We completed £1.1billion of lending in our first year.

person.headline: Chief Executive Officer | @Agria Pet Insurance

Raising the bar, daily.....personally and professionally.

I started my professional career in the Army.  My military career saw me do multiple operational tours and culminated with me taking just shy of 300 soldiers to Iraq as a Squadron Commander.  

I was lucky to be head-hunted out of the military into Aviva.  After working mainly across Europe, I finished my time in the Group as their Group Customer Strategy Director, harmonising the brand and marketing strategy across the Group after the brand launch from Norwich/Commercial Union to Aviva.

I moved to LV= from Aviva to become their Brand and Marketing Director.  The brand strategy and visual identity work that I led, created the LV= brand that you see today.  We relaunched the .co.uk platform and won google acclaims for the new site; we launched the first fixed-term annuity, in response to new the pension freedoms in 8 days including system changes, adviser and customer collateral etc; we hit our strategic target of becoming the market leader in Income Protection and we partnered with Wealth Wizards to provide the first on-line AI-led guidance proposition for our customers. 

I was head-hunted out of LV= to join Wesleyan as their Chief Customer and Strategy Officer.  I went on to have a seat around the Board table as a key ExCo member as the Chief Customer Officer, managing all the business P&L lines - just shy of £200m with a team of around 1,800.  Whilst at Wesleyan, I delivered an Org Design programme saving £18.3m over 2 years, set up the Wesleyan Foundation, wrote the current business strategy. 

I spent 12 months with Phoenix Group where I worked on the brand and strategy work that culminated in the purchase of the Standard Life Open Book brand and the Phoenix Group brand that you see today.

Agria is likely to be my final role prior to spending time with my family and my horses.  We have doubled GWP in 3 years since I joined in 2021, supported and enhanced our EVP and worked hard to deliver IT infrastructure that will enable us to scale, grow and respond.  We have launched 6 new products in just 2 years, some of which (Equine Lifetime and Service Dogs insurance for Dogs with Jobs) are market leading and differentiating.  We have also won multiple accolades as a Great Place to Work, won the top 4 slots on Which? best buy and we have an eNPS which has quadrupled in the 3 years since 2021.

I am the voice of the customer and our people around the Board table and I am deeply passionate about culture and how it can be built or eroded by leadership.

person.headline: CEO | @Brain in Hand
person.about_me:
Many  people fail to reach their potential not because of who they are but because of things beyond their control. This is most stark for people who are neurodivergent, or living with mental health difficulties. Their life chances are hugely affected by the way society is organised and people’s attitudes to disability and mental ill health. 

I want to change this by making it easier for the education, health and social care sectors in the UK to access the technology their service users need to overcome societal barriers that make it difficult to get support, access education, flourish in work and fully participate in society. 
 
I’m proud to be the CEO of Brain in Hand, an exciting business that’s impatient to change the way services are delivered to people who are neurodivergent or living with mental health difficulties.
 
Generally speaking, these people are poorly served by health and social care services. Thresholds are high and access to support is a postcode lottery. There is an urgent need to completely re-imagine how services are provided.
 
At Brain in Hand, we’ve developed a way of providing practical support at scale.
 
By combining the best of technology with the best of human support, we can deliver tools that are available whenever someone needs them - day or night.
 
Our system is incredibly effective at improving quality of life and reducing anxiety. It can also prevent an escalation of difficulties, reducing the need for high-cost, reactive services.
 
From a personal perspective, one reason I’m so motivated to tackle the barriers stopping people from achieving their potential is that I know how frustrating it is when organisations are slow to adopt the technology that could help the people in their care.

My son is dyslexic, and I quickly realised that the school system fails many dyslexic learners simply because it’s not set up to help them. I became a fierce advocate for my son, challenging the way he was taught and highlighting his lack of access to extra resources.
I spent 20 years in social research, working in the UK and internationally, developing, testing and disseminating innovations to improve the health and well-being of children and young people.
 
I’m now applying this experience to the growth of Brain In Hand - I know it has the potential to achieve impact at scale, and I’m determined to ensure it achieves that.
 
To date, I’ve managed to secure over £2m in non-dilutive grant funding for the business, but there is still much to do.
 
Please email me if you’d like to explore how Brain in Hand can help your organisation.

person.headline: Founder and COO, then CEO and Executive Chair | @GoHenry
person.about_me:
Co-founder and CEO of GoHenry - the prepaid debit card and financial education app designed to teach kids and teens how to be smart with money. Founding GoHenry back in 2012, I've been responsible for the global operations of the company for over 10 years as COO, before moving into the CEO position in 2023.  As such, I've seen GoHenry grow its customer base to over 2 million customers in the US & UK, and since 2022 Europe, with GoHenry’s acquisition of French Fintech Pixpay.   In early 2023 Gohenry was acquired by Acorns, creating a single company with over 6m customers, operating across the US, UK & EU delivering financial wellness to kids, teens and adults alike.

Listed as one of CrowdCube's top female fundraisers having broken its fundraising records in 2018. Since then, GoHenry has gone on to raise a total of $136M through a combination of direct investors, crowdfunding and growth equity. 
 
With over 20 years experience of running large-scale operations for some of the leading UK merchants, prior to GoHenry, I was at the forefront of the retail industry’s transition to digital, launching the first wave of e-commerce websites for some of the UK’s biggest brands, including Next Directory, John Lewis and Debenhams.
 
As a passionate advocate for financial education, I'm a Trustee of The Centre for Financial Capability, Chair of MyBnk’s Financial Freedom Campaign, a mentor for Oxford University’s accelerator programme (Creative Destruction Lab) and a speaker at leading Exec MBA programmes across the UK.  I'm also a huge supporter of women in business, regularly speaking at events and offering my time as a mentor for female founders, start-ups, and scaling businesses in order to drive cultural change around female leadership.

He designed and structured the new offshore umbrella fund (Henderson Horizon Fund) and established the company’s administration office in Luxembourg. The business quickly became one of the top 10 providers and John’s sales and marketing role became global in 1995 as he took on responsibility for Europe and Asia.  Following the acquisition by Aberdeen Asset Management, John was responsible for global mutual fund distribution and merging the unit trust and investment trust sales, marketing and administration departments of the two businesses.

Joining Houseful and the Zoopla Senior Leadership team was a natural next step for Rich after Mojo Mortgages was incorporated into the Homes Division in May 2023. He has since become the Chief Operating Officer for the Homes business unit, working alongside other leaders from the existing Homes Senior Leadership Team.

Richard founded Mojo Mortgages in 2017, and, with the help of a dedicated team, he secured the funds needed to launch its services across the UK, winning awards such as the British Bank Award for Best Mortgage Broker and Innovation of the Year. The Mojo business was acquired by RVU (who share the same ownership as Houseful) in December 2021 , which began the collaboration between Mojo and other established brands within RVU, such as Uswitch and Confused.com. Rich’s education came via a scholarship at Sylvia Young's performing arts college; an environment which taught him the value of resilience and adaptability. In 2019, he was named a Northern finalist at the EY Entrepreneur Of The Year, and later, Tech Entrepreneur of the Year at the 2020 Prolific North Tech Awards.

When not immersed in work, Richard finds solace in reading and reconnecting with nature through hiking and wild camping. Winters are reserved for skiing, a joy he now shares with his wife and three children. They remind him daily of the simple joys and adventures that life offers outside of boardrooms and business strategies.

I am the Managing Director of Price Bailey. 

I joined the firm in 1987 as a 19 year old trainee and in 2013 was elected Managing Director. I have previous held the positions of Head of Compliance and Risk Management, plus Chair of the Executive Board. 

Price Bailey is an award winning top 30 accountancy and business advisory firm, serving private clients and regional, national and international businesses. 

Today Price Bailey has a turnover in excess of £30million with over 350 professional people and 11 offices throughout East Anglia, London, Channel Islands, Eastern Caribbean and Dubai. 

In recent years Price Bailey has been extremely successful at the prestigious British Accountancy Awards where the firm has won the main award "National Firm of the Year" plus "Graduate and Non-Graduate Programme of the Year" and "Outstanding Community Engagement and Contribution" awards. Price Bailey has also been listed in The Sunday Times Top 100 Best Companies nationally to work for in 2019 and 2018, and regionally in 2021 and 2020.

We are a great firm with great clients and a fantastic team. I am very proud to be part of the success story of Price Bailey.

I continue to be Head of International Services at Price Bailey and was instrumental in the opening of Price Bailey's first international office in Guernsey, Channel Islands during 2009. We now also have a Caribbean offering from our location in St Lucia, and a Middle East presence in Dubai.

Price Bailey is a member of IAPA, an international association of professional firms. The international connections are important and in 2020 I was appointed IAPA CEO. Previously I have held positions of EMEA Chair, Global Chair and for over a year between 2016 and 2018 as Acting CEO. 

Price Bailey is a member of the UK200 Group, a UK association of accounting and legal firms. I am a member of UK200 Quality Assurance Standards committee

I am a CBI East of England Regional Council Member, Board Director of the Cambridgeshire Chamber of Commerce, Trustee and Treasurer of CamSight (A local charity founded in 1912 who supports people with low vision and blindness) and Governor at Cambridge Regional College. I am also a member of the APPG on Taxation.

I love watching live sport and theatre. I am regularly seen at Cambridge rugby, Cambridge football, Cambridge Arts Theatre, Newmarket Racecourses and I am a season ticker holder at West Ham United and Club Wembley. I am married to Janice and between us we have five adult children and a wayward black Labrador.

## What we do

At Pension Potential, we provide digital retirement guidance and advice to individuals, helping them make informed decisions about their pension and retirement options. Volodymyr Levykin is a space and tech entrepreneur with a longstanding record of launching and managing successful innovative businesses in the UK and Silicon Valley.

person.headline: CEO | @Òran Mór
person.about_me:
When I was 16 years old, my therapist presented me with 5 clothespins to pick from. Each one had a word engraved on them: Love❤️, Vulnerability🌈, Freedom🕊, Courage🌸, and Authenticity⭐️. At the time I didn’t know why, but I chose the one with Freedom. 

As I got older, I had someone ask me, “What’s your dream in one word?” Instantly Freedom came to mind, and it made me realize I was on this Earth to create an impact, not just an income. When I meet someone new I always like to ask them the same question that was asked to me. To my surprise, no one ever mentioned their job as their dream, but rather love, creation, happiness, time, equality, but never their job.🍀

Society teaches us that the traditional way in life is to go to college, get a degree, and get a job, but what if that path isn’t the right route for everyone. I truly do believe that education is important, but it isn’t knowledge that is power, it is the application of knowledge that garners results. 🏆

I didn’t get any of my jobs because I had a degree from a top tier school or because I had connections, but rather it was through the power of networking🗣, persistence💪, and the best asset is the will not skill🧠. I always tell my employers during interviews that I may not have the skillsets, but I do have the mindset. You can teach me how to do the job, but you cannot teach me character, that comes straight from within. We all were once nobodies that somebody took a chance on. And I want to be that somebody for someone out there.👫

I live by the motto “If it ain’t a hell yes, it’s a hell no.”💃I don’t believe in doing anything that does not align with my core values which are passion, creativity, authenticity, vulnerability, integrity, and most importantly Freedom. I am a firm believer that money💸does not dictate how successful I am in life, but rather by how passionate and fulfilled I am in my personal and professional life doing what I love, surrounded by like-minded individuals.🧘‍♀️✨

A Book Reader📚
A Podcast Lover🎧
A Mental Health Advocate❤️
An Artist 👩‍🎨 
A Writer ✍️ 
A Dreamer💫 
A Traveler🌍 
A kind-hearted philanthropist💖

Choose a job you love and you'll never have to work a day in your life is a quote I’ve never fully understood. On the one hand I love my job, but as for feeling I’ve never had to work a day in my life is a different matter. But for the majority of people how realistic is this quote to achieve?

As an HR Manager my job gives me the opportunity to influence innumerable aspects of the company I work for. I actively aid the development of our employees to watch them flourish, play a key role in influencing business decisions as part of our Senior Leadership Team and have grown our personnel by 83% in the last 3 years. But, to be successful in this profession you need to have a love for what you do as it doesn’t come without hard work, difficult decisions and challenging conversations (something that happens in my role almost everyday).

For me, I think drive and ambition to be successful (however you view that) can make you love the job you do - HR Management does this for me -  but do I really feel I've never worked a day in my life? 

It’s OK to feel like you're working extremely hard in order to get satisfaction from your job. I believe a good work ethic and determination will get you results, those results will give you job satisfaction which in turn can make you love your job. It’s always worked for me and keeps my passion for success in my field alive.

Reach out if your interested in a career at Bon Accord Life, looking for general career guidance, life coaching (my friends assure me I give great advice) or discussions about any HR topics - employee relations is a personal favourite.

WEX Europe Services (WES) was formed in 2014 as a joint venture business between WEX Inc and Radius Payment Solutions to acquire the European Fuel card business from Exxon Mobil. My focus is to build and lead the sales function to deliver on the growth agenda for the business . Our customer proposition is based upon the Esso fuel card solution supported by a multi card offering in order to provide enhanced coverage. In addition we are able to offer a genuine integrated telematics product.

person.headline: Recruitment and Retention Manager | @Wrigleys Solicitors
person.about_me:
I am the internal recruiter at Wrigleys Solicitors, a leading specialist law firm in Yorkshire. With over 10 years of experience in the staffing and recruiting industry, I have developed a valuable set of skills and methodologies that enable me to source and attract the very best legal talent across various practice areas, and levels of seniority. 

My commitment lies in delivering a professional yet authentic service to our colleagues and candidates, providing advice, guidance, and support throughout the entire recruitment and on-boarding process.
